name: Palacedomain
description: This district embodies the Empire’s three pillars: military strength, religious zeal, and arcane mastery. Baleroth’s court gathers the elite of the nobles, where hidden rivalries and political maneuvering unfold under the guise of piety or righteousness. Architectural splendor marks this district with pristine cobblestone pathways and gold-adorned mansions. At dusk, magical lanterns brighten enchanted gardens, all overlooked by the radiant Imperial Palace. Land ownership requires court approval. Commoners can use only designated roads to the Palace or Tamera’s temple and Orphanage. Nobles exclusively roam the inner lanes and parks under the protection of the Ironhand patrols, many leisurely walking with magical beasts on leashes to showcase their wealth and status, a practice that showcases the Empire’s culture of power and oppression. Adventurers here usually serve the court or influential noble houses. Though various jobs exist, they swiftly find themselves entangled in the court’s intricate politics orchestrated by Emperor Baleroth.
